case: default CSV import distinguishes a NULL custom enum array from an empty array
contract: With the default empty CSV null marker, a blank custom enum-array field imports as SQL NULL because the PostgreSQL empty array representation is `{}`.
An empty custom enum array remains a non-NULL empty array, and an array containing a SQL NULL element remains distinct.
Scalar custom-enum blank cells remain refused as ambiguous because the empty enum label and SQL NULL have the same blank CSV representation.
